segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And spread beneath me the bed of Your generosity
And bring me to the springs of Your mercy
And settle me in the spaciousness of Your Paradise
And do not label me as one turned away from You
And do not deprive me by Your rejection
And do not hold me accountable for what I have committed
Nor debate me about what I have acquired

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُبْرِزْ مَكْتُومِي، وَلَا تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي

segments.translation: And conceal from them what would disgrace me before You

1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.spread for me the bed of Your honour,
3.bring me to the wateringholes of Your mercy,
4.set me down in the midst of Your Garden,
5.stamp me not with rejection by You,
6.deprive me not through disappointment by You,
7.settle not accounts with me for what I have committed,
8.make no reckoning with me for what I have earned,

segments.arabic: وَلا تُـبْرِزْ مَكْتُوْمِي، وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي،

segments.translation: 9.display not what I have hidden, expose not what I have covered over,

segments.translation: 10.weigh not my works on the scales of fairness,

segments.transliteration: wat'-wi a'n-hum maa yul-h'iqunee i'ndaka shanaaraa
segments.translation: 13.and roll up before them all which would join me to disgrace with You!
14.Ennoble my degree through Your good pleasure,
15.perfect my honour through Your forgiveness,
16.rank me among the companions of the right hand,
17.direct me to the roads of the secure,
18.place me in the throng of the triumphant,
19.and through me let the sessions of the righteous thrive!
20.Amen, Lord of the worlds!

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
âIn the name of Allah,â the word of those who hold fast to Him,
the speech of those who seek His protection

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ مِنْ جَوْرِ ٱلْجَائِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu billahi ta`ala min jawri alja'irina
segments.translation: I seek refuge in Allah, high exalted is He, from the injustice of the unjust,
the trickery of the enviers,
and the oppression of the wrongdoers,
and I praise Him beyond the praise of the praisers!
O Allah, You are the One without partner,
and the King without having been made sovereign;
no one opposes You in Your decree
and no one contests You in Your kingdom.
I beseech You to bless Muhammad
Your servant and Your messenger,

segments.transliteration: wa an tuzi`ani min shukri na`maka
segments.translation: inspire me with a thanksgiving for Your favors
that You take to the utmost limit of Your good pleasure,
help me to obey You,
hold fast to worshiping You,
and deserve Your reward,
through the gentleness of Your solicitude

segments.translation: have mercy upon me, bar me from acts of disobedience to You as long as You keep me alive,

segments.translation: give me success in what profits me as long as You spare me,

lessen my burden through its recitation,

segments.translation: estrange not my intimates from me,

O Most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
O God, open for us the treasures of mercy

segments.arabic: لِأَنَّكَ الْبَاقِي الرَّحِيمُ الَّذِي تَسَرْبَلْتَ بِالرُّبُوبِيَّةِ

segments.translation: For You are the Everlasting, the Merciful, clothed in Lordship
And singular in divinity
And exalted beyond modality
No describer can define You by âhowâ

segments.arabic: اِلٰهِی بِیَدِکَ الْخَیْرُ وَ اَنْتَ وَلِیُّہٗ

Giver of desires and the ultimate goal of requests
I draw near to You through the vastness of Your mercy

segments.transliteration: AllatÄ« wasiÊ¿at kulla shayâ faqad tarÄ

segments.translation: My Lord, You see my place and know my inner self

segments.transliteration: Wa anta aqrabu ilayya min á¸¥abli l-warÄ«d

segments.translation: So accept my repentance and forgive me
A forgiveness after which I do not return to sin
O Most Generous of the generous

segments.arabic: اِلٰهِی أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَصْلَحْتَ قُلُوبَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

segments.translation: My God, You are the One who rectifies corrupt hearts

You corrected their slips and granted them Your love
And kept them away from disobedience

And settled them in the station of the successful

segments.translation: So I ask You, my Master, to join me with them
O Most Merciful of the merciful

segments.translation: O Allah, I ask You to bless Muhammad and his family

segments.transliteration: Wa an tarzuqanÄ« rizqan wÄsiÊ¿an á¸¥alÄlan á¹­ayyiban

segments.transliteration: FÄ« Ê¿Äfiyah wa Ê¿amalan yuqarribunÄ« ilayk

O Best of those who are asked

segments.arabic: اَللّٰہُمَّ وَ أَتَضَرَّعُ إِلَيْكَ ضَرَاعَةً مُقِرٍّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma wa ataá¸arraÊ¿u ilayka á¸arÄÊ¿atan muqirr Ê¿alÄ nafsih
segments.translation: O Allah, I humbly plead to You, confessing against myself
For my slips; I repent to You, O Accepter of repentance
Do not return me disappointed, O Bestower
For long You have been generous to sinners with forgiveness
And concealed ugly deeds
O Majestic, O Most High

segments.arabic: أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِمَنْ أَوْجَبْتَ حَقَّهُ عَلَيَّ

segments.translation: I turn to You through those whose right You made obligatory

segments.transliteration: Idh lam yakun lÄ« mina l-khayr mÄ atawajjahu bih
segments.translation: As I have no good deeds to present to You

segments.transliteration: Wa á¸¥Älat adh-dhunÅ«b baynÄ« wa bayna l-muá¸¥sinÄ«n
segments.translation: And sins have come between me and the righteous

segments.translation: And my deeds do not entitle me to the company of prophets

segments.transliteration: Wal-khalqu lahu Ê¿abÄ«d wa ilayhi maraddu l-umÅ«r
segments.translation: Creation are His servants and to Him return all matters

segments.translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

segments.translation: Which grants independence from near and far

segments.translation: And made them pure, righteous, God-conscious, and chosen

segments.translation: And neighbors of Your Prophet Muhammad in Your abode

segments.translation: And forgive me and the believing men and women

segments.translation: Along with fathers, mothers, brothers, and sisters
O Most Merciful of the merciful

segments.transliteration: ash-hadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah;
alone without having any partner;
and I bear witness that you are His messenger
and you are Muhammad, the son of `Abdullah.

segments.transliteration: wa ash-hadu annaka qad ballaghta risalati rabbika
segments.translation: And I bear witness that you have truly conveyed the missions of your Lord,
well-wished for your nation,
striven hard in the way of Allah
by means of wisdom and excellent preaching,
and fulfilled the duty that is incumbent upon you;
and you have been sympathetic with the believers
and unyielding to the unbelievers;
and you have worshipped Allah sincerely
until death came upon you.

segments.arabic: فَبَلَغَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَ أَشْرَفَ مَحَلِّ ٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ
segments.transliteration: fabalagha allahu bika ashrafa mahalli almukarramina
segments.translation: Allah therefore has lifted you up to the most honorable place of the honored ones.
All praise be to Allah Who has saved us, through you,
from polytheism and deviation.
O Allah, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,
and make Your blessings, the blessings of Your angels,
Your prophets, the Messengers,
Your righteous servants,
the inhabitants of the heavens and the [layers of the] earth,

segments.transliteration: wa man sabbaha laka ya rabba al`alamina
segments.translation: and ever one who glorifies You, O Lord of the worlds,
from the past and the late generations,
be on Muhammad, Your servant, messenger,
prophet, trustee,
elite, most-beloved,
elect, choice,
dignitary, select,
and the best of Your creatures.
And grant him preference, virtue,
[right of] mediation, and sublime rank;
and send him a praiseworthy status
which all the past and the late generations wish to have.
O Allah, You have said:

segments.transliteration: wa law annahum idh zalamu anfusahum
segments.translation: âAnd had they, when they were unjust to themselves,
come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah,
and the Messenger had also asked forgiveness for them,
they would have found Allah Oft-returning to mercy, Merciful.â
O my God, I have come to Your Prophet, seeking forgiveness of You
and repenting before You from my sins;
so, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household
and forgive them for me.
O our master,
I turn by you and by your Household

segments.translation: towards Allah, the Exalted, your and my Lord,
so that He may forgive me.

segments.translation: Verily, we are Allah's and verily unto Him shall we return.
We are stricken by losing you, O beloved of our hearts!
Too shocking is our misfortune of losing you!
Because the Revelation has been interrupted
and because we have missed you.

segments.translation: Nevertheless, we are Allahâs and to Him shall we return.
O our master, O Allahâs Messenger!

segments.transliteration: salawatu allahi `alayka wa `ala ali baytika alttahirina
segments.translation: May Allahâs blessings be upon you and upon your Household, the immaculate.

segments.translation: and on this day I am your guest and in your vicinity;
so, receive me as your guest and as your neighbor.
Indeed, you are generous and hospitable
and you are commanded [by Allah] to host your neighbors.
So, receive me as your guest and treat me hospitably;
and accept us as your neighbors and treat us in due hospitability;

segments.arabic: بِمَنْزِلَةِ ٱللَّهِ عِنْدَكَ وَعِنْدَ آلِ بَيْتِكَ
segments.translation: [I ask you] in the name of Allahâs standing with you and with your Household
and in the name of their standing with Him
and in the name of the knowledge that He has entrusted with you all.
Verily, He is the most generous of all those who show generosity.
In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Glory be to the God of truth.
Glory be to The Constrictor and the Outspreader.
Glory be to Him Who can expose anyone to loss or gain.
Glory be to the Judge with the truth.
Glory be to Him and to glorify Him is one of His graces.
Glory be to the Highest, the All-high.
Glory be to who has exalted in the air;
Glory be to Him, and most Exalted He be.
Glory be to The magnificent and beautiful.
Glory be to The All-Merciful and The Ever-Compassionate.
Glory be to The Creator and the Maker.
Glory be to The all Sufficient and the Praised.
Glory be to The highest and elevated.
Glory be to The Great and The Greatest.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ هَكَذَا وَ لَا يَكُونُ هَكَذَا غَيْرُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Him Who is in this state, and nothing else can be ever in his state.
Glorified (is He), Holy (is He), for Him the Living and the Forbearing.
Glory be to Allah, the Supreme!

segments.translation: Praise be to He! Glory be to him Who is alert and steady; never forgets one thing over another.

segments.translation: Glory be to him Who is vigilant; never is engrossed with a thing to overlook another.

segments.translation: Glory be to Him, Who is Independent that doesn't need.

segments.translation: Glory be to He who before his greatness everything bows.

segments.translation: Glory be to He who before his might everything overshadows.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ (اسْتَسْلَمَ‏) كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِقُدْرَتِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who everything surrenders for his power.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَضَعَ كُلُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِمُلْكِهِ
segments.translation: Glory be to him who everything obeyed to his kingdom.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنِ انْقَادَتْ لَهُ الْأُمُورُ بِأَزِمَّتِهَا
segments.translation: Glory be to him who all things follow His charge.
In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate,

segments.arabic: ‏ أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي بِاللهِ الَّذِي‏ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
segments.translation: I seek protection for myself in Allah, whom There is no god except Him, the living, the Everlasting.
Neither slumber overtakes Him nor sleep.

segments.arabic: لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ
segments.translation: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth.

segments.arabic: مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ
segments.translation: Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His permission?

segments.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ
segments.translation: He knows what is before them and what is behind them,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء
segments.translation: and they cannot grasp any of His knowledge except as He wills.
His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
segments.translation: and their preservation does not burden Him. He is the Highest, the Great.

segments.arabic: كَذَلِكَ اللهُ رَبُّنَا وَ سَيِّدُنَا وَ مَوْلَانَا
segments.translation: Allah, the One, the Refuge, has not begotten and has not been begotten,

segments.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ نُورُ النُّورِ وَ مُدَبِّرُ الْأُمُورِ
segments.translation: and equal to Him is not anyone, Light of the Light and the Regulator of affairs,
the Light of the heavens and the earth.

segments.arabic: مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكاةٍ فِيها مِصْباحٌ الْمِصْباحُ
segments.translation: The likeness of His Light is as a niche wherein is a lamp,

segments.arabic: فِي زُجاجَةٍ الزُّجاجَةُ كَأَنَّها كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ
segments.translation: the lamp in a glass, the glass as it were a glittering star
kindled from a Blessed Tree, an olive
that is neither of the East nor of the West,

segments.arabic: يَكادُ زَيْتُها يُضِيءُ وَ لَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نارٌ
segments.translation: whose oil well nigh would shine, even if no fire touched it.

segments.arabic: نُورٌ عَلى‏ نُورٍ يَهْدِي اللهُ لِنُورِهِ مَنْ يَشاءُ
segments.translation: Light upon Light God guides to His Light whom He will.
And God strikes similitudes for men,
and God has knowledge of everything.
He created the heavens and the earth

segments.arabic: بِالْحَقِّ وَ يَوْمَ يَقُولُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
segments.translation: by truth and the day, He says, Be, and it is

segments.arabic: قَوْلُهُ الْحَقُّ وَ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ
segments.translation: His saying is the truth, and to Him belongs the kingdom on the day when the trumpet are blown

segments.arabic: عالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَ الشَّهادَةِ وَ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ
segments.translation: He is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He is the All-wise, the All-Aware.

segments.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَماواتٍ طِباقاً وَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ
segments.translation: He created seven heavens, and they are like the earth.
Therefore, the Command descends through them so;

segments.arabic: لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللهَ عَلى‏ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.translation: that you may know that God is capable of everything.

segments.arabic: وَ أَنَّ اللهَ قَدْ أَحاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ عِلْماً
segments.translation: And that God Encompasses everything in knowledge
and has numbered everything in numbers.

segments.arabic: (وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرِّ مُعْلِنٍ بِهِ أَوْ مُسِرٍّ (مُسْتَتِرٍ
segments.translation: (I seek protection) from; the evil of everything possessed of evil, whether openly or secretly,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ الْجِنَّةِ وَ الْبَشَرِ
segments.translation: the evil of jinn and man,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَظْهَرُ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ يَكْمُنُ بِالنَّهَارِ
segments.translation: and the evil of what flies at night and rests during the day,

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ طَوَارِقِ اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ
segments.translation: and from the evils of the night and day

segments.arabic: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ الْحَمَّامَاتِ وَ الْحُشُوشَ
segments.translation: and from the evils of that which descends into the bathrooms and the lawn

segments.arabic: وَ الْخَرَابَاتِ وَ الْأَوْدِيَةَ وَ الصَّحَارِيَ
segments.translation: and the evil which lives in; ruins, valleys, desserts,

segments.arabic: وَ الغِيَاضَ وَ الشَّجَرَ وَ يَكُونُ فِي الْأَنْهَارِ
segments.translation: jungles and trees, and from that which is in rivers.

segments.arabic: وَ أُعِيذُ نَفْسِي وَ مَنْ يَعْنِينِي أَمْرُهُ بِالله
segments.translation: I seek the protection of Allah,

segments.arabic: ِ‏ مالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشاءُ
segments.translation: Master of the Kingdom, You give the Kingdom to whom Your wilt
and seizest the Kingdom from whom You wilt.

segments.arabic: وَ تُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشاءُ وَ تُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشاءُ
segments.translation: You honor whomever you will and humiliate whomever you will

segments.arabic: بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ إِنَّكَ عَلى‏ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.translation: In Your hand is the good. You are influential over everything.

segments.arabic: تُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهارِ وَ تُولِجُ النَّهارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ
segments.translation: You make the night to enter into the day, and You make the day to enter into the night.

segments.arabic: وَ تُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَ تُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ
segments.translation: You bring forth the living from the dead and the dead from the living

segments.arabic: وَ تَرْزُقُ مَنْ تَشاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسابٍ
segments.translation: and provide whomsoever wilt without reckoning.
To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth.
He stretches out His provision to whom He will.

segments.arabic: وَ يَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ عَلِيمٌ
segments.translation: Indeed He has knowledge of everything.
(I seek protection) from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens.
The All-compassionate seated himself upon the Throne.

segments.arabic: لَهُ ما فِي السَّماواتِ وَ ما فِي الْأَرْضِ
segments.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens, earth,

segments.arabic: وَ ما بَيْنَهُما وَ ما تَحْتَ الثَّرى‏
segments.translation: all that is between them, and all that is underneath the soil.

segments.arabic: وَ إِنْ تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَ أَخْفى‏ اللهُ
segments.translation: You be loud in Your speech, yet surely He knows the secret and that still more hidden.

segments.arabic: لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ الْأَسْماءُ الْحُسْنى‏ لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَ الْأَمْرُ
segments.translation: Allah-there is no god save He. To Him belong the Most New Beautiful Names, creation, and the Command.

segments.arabic: مُنْزِلُ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْإِنْجِيلِ وَ الزَّبُورِ وَ الْفُرْقَانِ الْعَظِيمُ
segments.translation: The revealer of the Torah, the Gospels (al-Injil), the Zabur, and the Mighty Furqan,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَاغٍ وَ بَاغٍ وَ نَافِثٍ وَ شَيْطَانٍ
segments.translation: from the evil of every tyrant and oppressor, demon,

segments.arabic: وَ سُلْطَانٍ وَ سَاحِرٍ وَ كَاهِنٍ وَ نَاظِرٍ وَ طَارِقٍ
segments.translation: ruler, enchanter, soothsayer, watcher, nocturnal visitor,

segments.arabic: وَ مُتَحَرِّكٍ وَ سَاكِنٍ وَ مُتَكَلِّمٍ وَ سَاكِتٍ
segments.translation: everything moving or still, and speaking and silent,

segments.arabic: وَ نَاطِقٍ وَ صَامِتٍ وَ مُتَخَيِّلٍ وَ مُتَمَثِّلٍ
segments.translation: and speaking, and silent, and imaginary and assimilated

segments.arabic: وَ مُتَلَوِّنٍ‏) وَ مُحْتَقِرٍ (وَ مُتَجَبِّرٍ) وَ نَسْتَجِيرُ )
segments.translation: apparent, changeable, or varying.

segments.arabic: بِاللهِ حِرْزِنَا وَ نَاصِرِنَا وَ مُونِسِنَا وَ هُوَ يَدْفَعُ عَنَّا
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, your Protector and Helper, and Solace. He will defend you.

segments.arabic: لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ لَا مُعِزَّ لِمَنْ أَذَلَّ
segments.translation: He has no partner. There is no one to elevate the one.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا مُذِلَّ لِمَنْ أَعَزَّ وَ هُوَ الْواحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
segments.translation: He abases nor anyone to abase the one He elevates. He is the One, the Subduer,

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and may Allah's peace be upon our master Muhammad
and his pure family.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ لَكَ الْمُلْكُ
segments.translation: O, Allah, for You the praise and the kingdom.

segments.arabic: وَ بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.translation: In Your Hand is all good, and You have the power over all things.
Glory be to You, for You the praise

segments.arabic: وَ التَّهْلِيلُ وَ التَّكْبِيرُ وَ التَّمْجِيدُ وَ التَّحْمِيدُ
segments.translation: and Tahlil, magnification, glorification, gratitude,

segments.arabic: وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ الْجَبَرُوتُ وَ الْمَلَكُوتُ وَ الْعَظَمَةُ
segments.translation: pride, force, dominion, greatness,

segments.arabic: وَ الْعُلُوُّ وَ الْوَقَارُ وَ الْجَمَالُ وَ الْعِزَّةُ وَ الْجَلَالُ
segments.translation: highness, solemnity, beauty, mightiness, majesty,

segments.arabic: وَ الْغَايَةُ وَ السُّلْطَانُ وَ الْمَنَعَةُ وَ الْعِزَّةُ وَ الْحَوْلُ
segments.translation: the aim, control, strength, Glory, solidity,

segments.arabic: وَ الْقُوَّةُ وَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةُ وَ الْخَلْقُ وَ الْأَمْرُ
segments.translation: power, the world, hereafter, the creation and the command
blessed and exalted be You, Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: وَ تَعَالَيْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ لَكَ الْبَهْجَةُ
segments.translation: Glory be to You, for You, the praise and; pleasantness,

segments.arabic: وَ الْجَمَالُ وَ الْبَهَاءُ وَ النُّورُ وَ الْوَقَارُ
segments.translation: gorgeousness, elegance, illumination, solemnity,

segments.arabic: وَ الْكَمَالُ وَ الْعِزَّةُ وَ الْجَلَالُ وَ الْفَضْلُ
segments.translation: perfection, mightiness, majesty, grace,

segments.arabic: وَ الْإِحْسَانُ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ وَ الْجَبَرُوتُ
segments.translation: goodwill, pride, mightiness,
and stretched mercy and wellness.

segments.arabic: وَ وُلِّيتَ الْحَمْدَ (وَحْدَكَ‏) لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
segments.translation: You fulfilled (only you) for the praise;
You alone, who has no associate, You are Allah, nothing is like You.

segments.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ وَ أَعَزَّ سُلْطَانَكَ
segments.translation: Therefore Glory be to you, how mighty is Your station, how treasured is Your authority,
how great is Your force.
Therefore, Glory be to You,

segments.arabic: الْخَلْقُ كُلُّهُمْ لَكَ وَ قَامَ الْخَلْقُ كُلُّهُمْ بِكَ
segments.translation: all the creation glorifies You, stood up by You,

segments.arabic: وَ أَشْفَقَ الْخَلْقُ كُلُّهُمْ مِنْكَ وَ ضَرَعَ الْخَلْقُ
segments.translation: frightened by You, and supplicated by you.

segments.arabic: كُلُّهُمْ إِلَيْكَ وَ سُبْحَانَكَ تَسْبِيحاً يَنْبَغِي لَكَ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, with a glorification indeed to You

segments.arabic: وَ لِوَجْهِكَ وَ يَبْلُغُ مُنْتَهَى عِلْمِكَ
segments.translation: and Your Being; reaches your knowledge's end,

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَقْصُرُ دُونَ أَفْضَلِ رِضَاكَ
segments.translation: doesn't fail your splendid satisfaction

segments.arabic: وَ لَا يَفْضُلُهُ شَيْ‏ءٌ مِنْ مَحَامِدِ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: and not preferred by your laudation creation.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ خَلَقْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِلَيْكَ مَعَادُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to you, You created everything that; for you will be returned,

segments.arabic: وَ بَدَأْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِلَيْكَ مُنْتَهَاهُ
segments.translation: started everything that; to you will end,

segments.arabic: وَ أَنْشَأْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ إِلَيْكَ مَصِيرُهُ
segments.translation: originated everything that; will be destined to you,
and you are the most merciful of the merciful ones.

segments.arabic: بِأَمْرِكَ ارْتَفَعَتِ السَّمَاءُ وَ وُضِعَتِ الْأَرَضُونَ
segments.translation: In your order, the heavens rose, the earth delivered,

segments.arabic: وَ أُرْسِيَتِ الْجِبَالُ وَ سُجِّرَتِ الْبُحُورُ
segments.translation: firmed the mountains, made the seas overflow;
therefore, your authority is above every kingdom.
Therefore, blessed you are by your mercy, exalted you are by your clemency,
glorified You are in your solemnity place.
Praising are for Your clemency,
glorification for your graces,

segments.arabic: وَ لَكَ الْحَوْلُ بِقُوَّتِكَ  وَ لَكَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ
segments.translation: solidity for your strength, pride in your greatness.

segments.arabic: بِعَظَمَتِكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ الْجَبَرُوتُ بِسُلْطَانِكَ
segments.translation: For your authority the praise and strength,

segments.arabic: وَ لَكَ الْمَلَكُوتُ بِعِزَّتِكَ وَ لَكَ الْقُدْرَةُ بِمُلْكِكَ
segments.translation: Your might for your kingdom, the ability in your authority,

segments.arabic: وَ لَكَ الرِّضَا بِأَمْرِكَ وَ لَكَ الطَّاعَةُ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: the satisfaction by your command, and obedience upon your creation;

segments.arabic: أَحْصَيْتَ‏ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَداً وَ أَحَطْتَ‏ بِكُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ عِلْماً
segments.translation: counted everything in numbers, encompass all things with knowledge,

segments.arabic: وَ وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ رَحْمَةً وَ أَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segments.translation: embracest everything in mercy, and are the most merciful of the merciful ones;
Mightiness is great; authority is well-beloved,

segments.arabic: قَوِيُّ الْبَطْشِ مَلِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ
segments.translation: punishment is severe; the king of the heavens and earth,
the Lord of all the worlds; The Lord of the great Throne,
and favorite angels praising
night and day; without showing sluggishness.

segments.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ أَبَدَ الْآبِدِ
segments.translation: Therefore, Glory be to Him who never dies,

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ أَبَدَ الْآبِدِ
segments.translation: Glory be to the ever Lord of Majesty,

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الْقُدُّوسِ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ أَبَدَ الْآبِدِ
segments.translation: Glory be to the ever holy majesty,

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَ الرُّوحِ
segments.translation: Lord, Glory be to the Lord of the Angles and heavenly spirits.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي وَ تَعَالَى
segments.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Highest. Glory be to my Lord, the exalted.
Glory be to Him, who is His throne in the heavens
and his power (satisfaction) on earth.

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي فِي الْقُبُورِ قَضَاؤُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah Whose decree is in the graves.

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ رِضَاهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Whose pleasure is in paradise.

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي فِي الْبَحْرِ سَبِيلُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Who surfaced a path over the ocean!

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي فِي جَهَنَّمَ سُلْطَانُهُ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah, Who has the mightiness in hell!
Glory be to Allah Whose mercy overtakes His Wrath.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَهُ‏ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْإِبْكَارِ
segments.translation: Glory be to Allah when ye enter evening, Glory be to Allah when ye enter the morning.

segments.arabic: وَ سُبْحَانَهُ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ عَزَّ وَجْهُهُ وَ نَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ
segments.translation: Glory and Praise for His almightiness being; who granted His servant victory,

segments.arabic: وَ عَلَا اسْمُهُ وَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَقَدَّسَ فِي مَجْلِسِ وَقَارِهِ وَ كُرْسِيِّ عَرْشِهِ
segments.translation: exalted and blessed His name, hallowed You are in your solemnity place and throne chair.

segments.arabic: يَرَى كُلَّ عَيْنٍ وَ لَا تَرَاهُ كُلُّ عَيْنٍ
segments.translation: Sees every eye; neither eye can see Him!

segments.arabic: وَ يُدْرِكُ كُلَّ شَيْ‏ءٍ وَ لا تُدْرِكُهُ الْأَبْصارُ
segments.translation: He is Comprehending everything while visions cannot comprehend Him,

segments.arabic: وَ هُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْأَبْصارَ وَ هُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ
segments.translation: yet He comprehends all visions! He is the Knower of subtleties, the Aware.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ  وَ نَبِيِّكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad, Your servant, messenger, and prophet;

segments.arabic: أَمْراً اخْتَصَصْتَنَا بِهِ دُونَ مَنْ عَبَدَ غَيْرَكَ وَ تَوَلَّى سِوَاكَ
segments.translation: a matter you distinguished us, excluding them who worships and embraces other than You.

segments.arabic: وَ صَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ بِمَا انْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ مِنْ
segments.translation: Therefore, Allah's blessings upon him with what you;

segments.arabic: رِسَالَتِكَ وَ أَكْرَمْتَهُ بِهِ مِنْ نُبُوَّتِكَ
segments.translation: distinguished him from your message and dignified him from your prophecy.

segments.arabic: وَ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا النَّظَرَ   إِلَى وَجْهِهِ
segments.translation: Do not deprive us of; looking to his face,

segments.arabic: وَ الْكَوْنَ مَعَهُ فِي دَارِكَ وَ مُسْتَقَرٍّ مِنْ جِوَارِكَ
segments.translation: being with him in Your home, residing at your safeguard.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا أَرْسَلْتَهُ فَبَلَّغَ وَ حَمَّلْتَهُ
segments.translation: O, Allah, as you sent him, he informed and charged him with he delivered;
until your authority has been shown

segments.arabic: وَ آمَنَ بِكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
segments.translation: and believed in you, no partner with you.

segments.arabic: فَضَاعِفِ اللَّهُمَّ ثَوَابَهُ وَ كَرَمَهُ بِقُرْبِهِ
segments.translation: Therefore, O, Allah duplicates his reward and salutes him by your closeness,

segments.arabic: مِنْكَ‏ كَرَامَةً يُفَضَّلُ بِهَا عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ
segments.translation: a preferred dignity above all Your creation,

segments.arabic: وَ يَغْبِطُهُ بِهِ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَ الْآخَرُونَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
segments.translation: which the past and last generations of your worshippers will wish to have.

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ مَثْوَانَا مَعَهُ فِيمَا لَا ظَعْنَ لَهُ مِنْهُ
segments.translation: Make our abode with him, where there is no leave from it,
O, Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَوْلِكَ وَ قُوَّتِكَ وَ طَوْلِكَ وَ مَنِّكَ
segments.translation: and I ask You by your; might, power, graciousness, generosity,

segments.arabic: وَ عَظِيمِ مُلْكِكَ وَ جَلَالِ ذِكْرِكَ وَ كِبَرِ مَجْدِكَ
segments.translation: great kingdom, majestic reputation, splendid glorious,

segments.arabic: وَ عِظَمِ سُلْطَانِكَ وَ لُطْفِ جَبَرُوتِكَ
segments.translation: great power, lenity mightiness,

segments.arabic: وَ تَجَبُّرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَ حِلْمِ عَفْوِكَ وَ تَحَنُّنِ رَحْمَتِكَ
segments.translation: displays Your overwhelming power greatness, clemency pardon, tender mercy,

segments.arabic: وَ تَمَامِ كَلِمَاتِكَ وَ نَفَاذِ أَمْرِكَ
segments.translation: complete words, and execution of Your command;

segments.arabic: وَ رُبُوبِيَّتِكَ الَّتِي دَانَ لَكَ بِهَا كُلُّ ذِي رُبُوبِيَّةٍ
segments.translation: Your Lordship, which each believer embraces,

segments.arabic: وَ أَطَاعَكَ بِهَا كُلُّ ذِي طَاعَةٍ
segments.translation: obeyed by every obeyance,

segments.arabic: وَ تَقَرُّبٍ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ كُلُّ ذِي رَغْبَةٍ فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ
segments.translation: each of desire your pleasure will seek its nearness

segments.arabic: وَ يَلُوذُ بِهَا كُلُّ ذِي رَهْبَةٍ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
segments.translation: and each of fear your displeasure will resort to it.

segments.arabic: أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي فَوَاتِحَ الْخَيْرِ وَ خَوَاتِمَهُ وَ ذَخَائِرَهُ
segments.translation: So do bless me with goodness beginning, finale, supply,

segments.arabic: وَ جَوَائِزَهُ (وَ فَوَاضِلَهُ) وَ فَضَائِلَهُ وَ خَيْرَهُ وَ نَوَافِلَهُ
segments.translation: rewards, benefits, reasonable, and support.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ اهْدِ بِالْيَقِينِ مُعْلَنَنَا وَ أَصْلِحْ بِالْيَقِينِ
segments.translation: guide our declared one by certainty, reform our secrets thought by certainty,

segments.arabic: سَرَائِرَنَا وَ اجْعَلْ قُلُوبَنَا مُطْمَئِنَّةً إِلَى ذِكْرِكَ
segments.translation: make our hearts entirely tranquil to your mention
and our deeds sincerely intended for You.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ الرِّبْحَ مِنَ التِّجَارَةِ الَّتِي لَا تَبُورُ
segments.translation: I ask You for; commerce that comes not to naught,

segments.arabic: وَ الْغَنِيمَةَ مِنَ الْأَعْمَالِ الْخَالِصَةِ الْفَاضِلَةِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: benefit in this worldly existence and hereafter from the immaculate gracefully deeds,

segments.arabic: وَ الذِّكْرَ الْكَثِيرَ لَكَ وَ الْعَفَافَ وَ السَّلَامَةَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَ الْخَطَايَا
segments.translation: the heavy mention of You, chasteness and safety from the vices and sins.
O, Allah, bless me with blameless accepted works

segments.arabic: تَرْضَى بِهَا عَنَّا وَ تُسَهِّلَ لَنَا سَكْرَةَ الْمَوْتِ
segments.translation: that make You pleased upon us with and ease the agony of death
and the intense horror of the Resurrection Day.
O, Allah, we ask You for the special goodness

segments.arabic: وَ عَامَّتَهُ لِخَاصِّنَا وَ عَامِّنَا وَ الزِّيَادَةَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
segments.translation: and the general for both of us, unique and regular, increasing your sustenance;

segments.arabic: فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَ لَيْلَةٍ وَ النَّجَاةَ مِنْ عَذَابِكَ
segments.translation: every day and night and deliverance from Your torture
and winning your mercy.
O, Allah makes us love meeting You,
reward us witnessing your face,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي لِقَائِكَ‏ نَضْرَةً وَ سُرُوراً
segments.translation: and make us meet You with ease and happiness.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ أَحْضِرْنَا ذِكْرَكَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ غَفْلَةٍ
segments.translation: gain us your mention in every distraction time,

segments.arabic: وَ شُكْرَكَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ نِعْمَةٍ وَ الصَّبْرَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ بَلَاءٍ
segments.translation: thank you in every blessing, patience on every misfortune,

segments.arabic: وَ ارْزُقْنَا قُلُوباً وَجِلَةً مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ خَاشِعَةً
segments.translation: and bless us with quake hearts in your dread;
devoted to Your mention and repentant to You!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah: send blessings upon Muhammad and His Household,

segments.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يُوفِي بِعَهْدِكَ وَ يُؤْمِنُ بِوَعْدِكَ
segments.translation: make us among them who fulfill your promises, believe in your words,

segments.arabic: وَ يَعْمَلُ بِطَاعَتِكَ وَ يَسْعَى فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ
segments.translation: work on Your obeying, aim at your excellent pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَ يَرْغَبُ‏ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ وَ يَفِرُّ إِلَيْكَ مِنْكَ
segments.translation: wants what You have, escape from You to You,

segments.arabic: وَ يَرْجُو أَيَّامَكَ (أَمَانَكَ‏) وَ يَخَافُ سُؤ َ حِسَابِكَ
segments.translation: anticipate your days, fear Your Day of Reckoning,

segments.arabic: وَ يَخْشَاكَ حَقَّ خَشْيَتِكَ وَ اجْعَلْ ثَوَابَ أَعْمَالِنَا
segments.translation: fear You with dread, make our deeds reward

segments.arabic: جَنَّتَّكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ ذُنُوبِنَا بِرَأْفَتِكَ
segments.translation: Your heaven with Your mercy, overlook our sins with your mercifulness,

segments.arabic: وَ أَعِذْنَا مِنْ ظُلْمَةِ خَطَايَانَا بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ
segments.translation: we seek refuge in Allah from the darkness of our sins with Your illuminance face,

segments.arabic: وَ تَغَمَّدْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ وَ أَلْبِسْنَا عَافِيَتَكَ
segments.translation: encompass us with your benefits, veil us with your wellness,

segments.arabic: وَ هَنِّئْنَا كَرَامَتَكَ وَ أَتْمِمْ عَلَيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ
segments.translation: felicitate us with Your miracles, complete for us Your favors,
and give as due share on praising Your mercy.
May it be so Allah of Truth, Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ
segments.translation: Allah's blessings upon our Master Muhammad are the seal of the prophets
and his immaculate household.

segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
All praise is for Allah, in satisfaction with His decree.

segments.arabic: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ،

segments.translation: I bear witness that Allah divided the livelihoods of His servants with justice.
And He deals with all His creation with grace.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
And do not test me with what You have given them.
And do not test them with what You withheld from me.
So that I do not envy Your creation, nor reject Your judgment.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.
And make my soul content with Your decree.
And expand my chest through the places of Your judgment.
And grant me trust so that I acknowledge with itâ

segments.transliteration: bi-anna qaá¸Äâaka lam yajri illÄ bil-khÄ«rati
segments.translation: That Your decree runs only with wisdom and goodness.

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ شُكْرِي لَكَ عَلَى مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي،
segments.transliteration: wa-jâal shukrÄ« laka âalÄ mÄ zawayta âannÄ«
segments.translation: And make my gratitude to You for what You withheld from meâ

segments.arabic: أَوْفَرَ مِنْ شُكْرِي إِيَّاكَ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي.
segments.transliteration: awfara min shukrÄ« iyyÄka âalÄ mÄ khawwaltanÄ«
segments.translation: Greater than my gratitude for what You granted me.

segments.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ أَنْ أَظُنَّ بِذِي عَدَمٍ خَسَاسَةً،
segments.transliteration: wa-âá¹£imnÄ« min an aáºunna bidhÄ« âadamin khasÄsatan
segments.translation: And protect me from thinking the poor are lowly.
Or from thinking that the wealthy have virtue.
For the noble one is he whom Your obedience ennobles.
And the mighty is he whom Your worship strengthens.
So bless Muhammad and his family.
And grant us an endless wealth.
And support us with a strength that never vanishes.
And let us roam freely in the kingdom of eternity.
Indeed, You are the One, the Only, the Eternal Refuge.
The One who neither begets nor is begotten.
And none is comparable to You.

segments.transliteration: aal-h'am-du ll-lahee riz''an bih'uk-mil-laah shahit-tu an-nal-laah
segments.translation: 1.Praise belongs to God in satisfaction with God's decision!

segments.arabic: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ ،
segments.translation: 2.I bear witness that God has apportioned the livelihoods of His servants with justice

segments.transliteration: wa akhad'a a'laa jameei' khal-qihee bil-faz''-l
segments.translation: 3.and undertaken bounty for all His creatures.
4.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
5.tempt me not with what You hast given to Your creatures

segments.arabic: وَلا تَفْتِنْهُمْ بِمَا مَنَعْتَنِي فَأحْسُدَ خَلْقَكَ، وَأَغْمِطَ حُكْمَكَ.
segments.transliteration: wa laa taf-tin-hum bimaa manaa'-tanee faah'-suda khal-qak wa agh-mit'a h'uk-mak
segments.translation: 6.and tempt them not with what You hast withheld from me, lest I envy Your creatures and despise Your decision!
7.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
8.delight my soul through Your decree,
9.expand my breast through the instances of Your decision,
10.give to me a trust through which I may admit

segments.translation: 11.that Your decree runs only to the best,

segments.transliteration: aw-fara min shuk-reee ee-yaaka a'laa maa khaw-wal-tanee
segments.translation: 13.be more abundant than my gratitude to You for what You hast conferred upon me!

segments.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِن أنْ أظُنَّ بِذِي عَدْم خَسَاسَةً،
segments.transliteration: waa'-s'im-nee min an az'un-na bid'ee a'damin khasaasah
segments.translation: 14.Preserve me from imagining any meanness in someone who is destitute
15.or imagining any superiority in someone who possesses wealth,
16.for the noble is he whom obedience to You has ennobled
17.and the exalted is he whom worship of You has exalted!
18.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَمَتِّعْنَا بِثَرْوَة لاَ تَنْفَدُ، وَأَيِّدْنَا بِعِزٍّ لاَ يُفْقَدُ
segments.transliteration: wa mat-tia'-naa bithar-watil-laa tanfad wa ay-yid-naa bii'z-zil-laa yuf-qad
segments.translation: 19.give us to enjoy a wealth which does not run out, confirm us with an exaltation which will never be lost,
20.and let us roam freely in the kingdom of everlastingness!
21.Surely You art the One, 'the Unique, the Eternal Refuge;
22.You hast not begotten, nor hast You been begotten,
23.and equal to You is not any one' (ref.112:1-4)!

So the doomed among us is he who perishes against Him

segments.arabic: وَ السَّعِيدُ مِنَّا مَنْ رَغِبَ إلَيْهِ
segments.translation: And the happy among us is he who turns in desire toward Him

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَمْد للهِ بِكُلِّ مَا حَمِدَهُ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wal-á¸¥amdu lillÄhi bikulli mÄ á¸¥amidahu bihi
segments.translation: And praise be to Allah with every praise with which
The nearest of His angels to Him
And the noblest of His creatures from Him
And the most pleasing of those who praise Him before Him
A praise that excels all other praise
Like the superiority of our Lord over all His creation

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ مَكَانَ كُلِّ نِعْمَة لَهُ عَلَيْنَا
segments.transliteration: Thumma lahu al-á¸¥amdu makÄna kulli niâmatin lahu âalaynÄ
segments.translation: Then His is the praise in place of every blessing He has given us

segments.arabic: وَ عَلى جَمِيعِ عِبَادِهِ الْمَاضِينَ وَالْبَاقِينَ
segments.transliteration: Wa âalÄ jamÄ«âi âibÄdihi al-mÄá¸Ä«na wal-bÄqÄ«n
segments.translation: And upon all His servants, those past and those remaining

segments.arabic: عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْاشْيَآءِ
segments.transliteration: âAdada mÄ aá¸¥Äá¹­a bihi âilmuhu min jamÄ«âil-ashyÄâ
segments.translation: According to the number encompassed by His knowledge of all things

segments.arabic: وَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ وَاحِدَة مِنْهَا عَدَدُهَا أَضْعافَاً مُضَاعَفَةً أَبَداً سَرْمَداً إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
segments.transliteration: Wa makÄna kulli wÄá¸¥idatin minhÄ âadaduha aá¸âÄfan muá¸Äâafatan abadan sarmadan ilÄ yawmil-qiyÄmah
segments.translation: And in place of each one of them multiplied times, forever, endlessly, until the Day of Resurrection
A praise without limit to its boundary
No reckoning for Its number
No reaching of its goal
And no end to its duration

segments.arabic: حَمْدَاً يَكُونُ وُصْلَةً إلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَعَفْوِهِ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan yakÅ«nu wuá¹£latan ilÄ á¹­Äâatihi wa âafwihi
segments.translation: A praise that may be a means to His obedience and pardon
And a cause for His pleasure
And a way to His forgiveness
And a path to His Garden
And a shield from His wrath
And a security from His anger
And an aid to His obedience
And a barrier against disobedience to Him

segments.arabic: وَعَوْناً عَلَى تَأدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ وَ وَظائِفِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa âawnan âalÄ taâdiyati á¸¥aqqihi wa waáºÄâifihi
segments.translation: And a support in fulfilling His right and duties

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نَسْعَدُ بِهِ فِي السُّعَدَاءِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآئِهِ
segments.transliteration: á¸¤amdan nasâadu bihi fi-s-suâadÄâi min awliyÄâihi
segments.translation: A praise by which we may be among His happy friends

segments.arabic: وَنَصِيرُ بِهِ فِي نَظْمِ الشُّهَدَآءِ بِسُيُوفِ أَعْدَائِهِ
segments.transliteration: Wa naá¹£Ä«ru bihi fÄ« naáºmi-sh-shuhadÄâi bisuyÅ«fi aâdÄâihi
segments.translation: And by which we may join the martyrs in line, by the swords of His enemies
Indeed, He is the Praiseworthy Guardian
1.Praise belongs to God,
2.the First, without a first before Him,

segments.arabic: وَ الاخِر بِلاَ آخِر يَكُونُ بَعْدَهُ
segments.translation: 3.the Last, without a last behind Him.
4.Beholders' eyes fall short of seeing Him,

segments.arabic: وَ عَجَزَتْ عَنْ نَعْتِهِ أَوهامُ اَلْوَاصِفِينَ
segments.translation: 5.describers' imaginations are not able to depict Him.
6.He originated the creatures through His power with an origination,
7.He devised them in accordance with His will with a devising.
8.Then He made them walk on the path of His desire,
9.He sent them out on the way of His love.

segments.transliteration: laa yam-likoona taa-kheerana a'm-maa qad-damahum ilay-h
segments.translation: 10.They cannot keep back from that to which He has sent them forward,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَقَدُّماً إلَى مَا أَخَّرَهُمْ عَنْهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa laa yas-tat'eeu'wna taqad-duman ilaa maaa akh-kharahum a'n-h
segments.translation: 11.nor can they go forward to that from which He has kept them back.
12.He assigned from His provision to each of their spirits
13.a nourishment known and apportioned.
14.No decreaser decreases those whom He increases,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَزِيدُ مَنْ نَقَصَ منْهُمْ زَائِدٌ
segments.transliteration: wa laa yazeedu man-naqas'a min-hum zaaa-id
segments.translation: 15.no increaser increases those of them whom He decreases.

segments.arabic: ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ لَهُ فِي الْحَيَاةِ أَجَلاً مَوْقُوتاً،
segments.translation: 16.Then for each spirit He strikes a fixed term in life,
17.for each He sets up a determined end;
18.he walks toward it through the days of his span,
19.he overtakes it through the years of his time.
20.Then, when he takes his final step
21.and embraces the reckoning of his span,
22.God seizes him to the abundant reward

segments.arabic: مِنْ مَوْفُورِ ثَوَابِهِ أَوْ مَحْذُورِ عِقَابِهِ،
segments.translation: 23.or the feared punishment to which He has called him,
24."That He may repay those who do evil for what they have done
25.and repay those who do good with goodness" (53:31),
26.as justice from Him (holy are His names,
27.and manifest His boons).

segments.arabic: لاَ يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ
segments.translation: 28."He shall not be questioned as to what He does, but they shall be questioned" (21:23).

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي لَوْ حَبَسَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ مَعْرِفَةَ
segments.transliteration: wal-h'am-du lil-laahil-lad'ee law h'abasa a'n i'baadihee maa'-rifata
segments.translation: 29.Praise belongs to God, for, had He withheld from His servants the knowledge

segments.arabic: حَمْدِهِ عَلَى مَا أَبْلاَهُمْ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ الْمُتَتَابِعَةِ
segments.translation: 30.to praise Him for the uninterrupted kindnesses with which He has tried them
31.and the manifest favours which He has lavished upon them,
32.they would have moved about in His kindnesses without praising Him,

segments.transliteration: wa tawas-sau'wa fee riz-qihee falam yash-kurooh
segments.translation: 33.and spread themselves out in His provision without thanking Him.

segments.arabic: وَلَوْ كَانُوا كَذلِكَ لَخَرَجُوا مِنْ حُدُودِ الانْسَانِيَّةِ
segments.transliteration: wa law kaanoo kad'alika lakharajoo min h'udoodil-insaanee-yah
segments.translation: 34.Had such been the case, they would have left the bounds of humanity
35.for that of beastliness

segments.transliteration: fakaanoo kamaa was'afa fee muh'-kami kitaabihi:
segments.translation: 36.and become as He has described in the firm text of His Book:

segments.arabic: ( إنْ هُمْ إلا كَالانْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلا )
segments.transliteration: (in hum il-laa kal-an-a'ami bal hum az''al-lu sabeelaa)
segments.translation: 37."They are but as the cattleânay, but they are further astray from the way"! (25:46)

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لله عَلَى مَا عَرَّفَنا من نفسه
segments.transliteration: wal-h'am-du lil-lahee a'laa maa a'r-rafanaa min-naf-sih
segments.translation: 38.Praise belongs to God, for the true knowledge of Himself He has given to us,
39.the thanksgiving He has inspired us to offer Him,

segments.arabic: وَفَتَحَ لَنَا من أبوَابِ الْعِلْمِ بِرُبُوبِيّته
segments.transliteration: wa fatah'a lanaa min ab-waabil-i'l-mi biruboobee-yatih
segments.translation: 40.the doors to knowing His Lordship He has opened for us,

segments.arabic: وَدَلَّنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الاِخْلاَصِ لَهُ فِي تَوْحِيدِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa dal-lanaa a'lay-hee minal-ikh-laas'i lahoo fee taw-h'eedih
segments.translation: 41.the sincerity towards Him in professing His Unity to which He has led us,

segments.arabic: وَجَنَّبَنا مِنَ الالْحَادِ وَالشَّكِّ فِي أَمْرِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa jan-nabanaa minal-il-h'aadi wash-shak-ki feee am-rih
segments.translation: 42.and the deviation and doubt in His Command from which He has turned us aside;

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نُعَمَّرُ بِهِ فِيمَنْ حَمِدَهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan nua'm-maru bihee fee man h'amidahoo min khal-qih
segments.translation: 43.a praise through which we may be given long life among those of His creatures who praise Him,

segments.arabic: وَنَسْبِقُ بِـهِ مَنْ سَبَقَ إلَى رِضَاهُ وَعَفْوِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa nas-biqu bihee man sabaqa ilaa riz''aahoo wa a'f-wih
segments.translation: 44.and overtake those who have gone ahead toward His good pleasure and pardon;

segments.arabic: حَمْداً يُضِيءُ لَنَا بِهِ ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرْزَخِ
segments.translation: 45.a praise through which He will illuminate for us the shadows of the interworld,
46.ease for us the path of the Resurrection,

segments.arabic: وَيُشَرِّفُ بِهِ مَنَازِلَنَا عِنْدَ مَوَاقِفِ الاشْهَادِ
segments.transliteration: wa yushar-rifu bihee manaazilanaa i'nda mawaaqifil-ash-haadi
segments.translation: 47.and raise up our stations at the standing places of the Witnesses

segments.arabic: يَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْس بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لا يُظْلَمُونَ
segments.transliteration: yaw-ma tuj-zaa kul-lu naf-sim-bimaa kasabat wa hum laa yuz'-lamoon
segments.translation: 48."on the day when every soul will be repaid for what it has earned - they shall not be wronged" (45:21);

segments.arabic: (يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلىً عَنْ مَوْلىً شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ)
segments.transliteration: (yaw-ma laa yugh-nee maw-lana a'm-maw-lana shay-aw-wa laa hum yuns'aroon)
segments.translation: 49."the day a master shall avail nothing a client, and they shall not be helped" (44:41);

segments.arabic: حَمْداً يَرْتَفِعُ مِنَّا إلَى أَعْلَى عِلِّيِّينَ
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan yar-tafiu' min-naaa ilaaa aa'-laa i'l-lee-yeena
segments.translation: 50.a praise which will rise up from us to the highest of the 'Illiyun
51."in a book inscribed, witnessed by those brought nigh" (83:20-21),

segments.arabic: حَمْداً تَقَرُّ بِهِ عُيُونُنَا إذَا بَرِقَت الابْصَارُ
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan taqar-ru bih u'yoonunaaa id'aa bariqatil-ab-s'aar
segments.translation: 52.a praise whereby our eyes may be at rest when sight is dazzled,

segments.arabic: وَتَبْيَضُّ بِهِ وُجُوهُنَا إذَا اسْوَدَّتِ الابْشَارُ،
segments.transliteration: wa tab-yaz''-z''u bihee wujoohunaaa id'aa as-wad-datil-abshaar
segments.translation: 53.our faces whitened when skins are blackened,

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نُعْتَقُ بِهِ مِنْ أَلِيمِ نار الله
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan nua'-taqu bihee min aleemi naaril-laahee
segments.translation: 54.a praise through which we may be released from God's painful Fire
55.and enter God's generous neighbourhood,
56.a praise by which we may jostle the angels brought nigh
57.and join the prophets, the envoys,

segments.arabic: فِي دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ الَّتِي لا تَزُولُ
segments.translation: 58.in a House of Permanence that does not remove,
59.the Place of His Generosity that does not change.

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي اخْتَارَ لَنَا مَحَاسِنَ الْخَلْقِ
segments.translation: 60.Praise belongs to God, who chose for us the good qualities of creation,
61.granted us the agreeable things of provision,

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لَنَا الفَضِيلَةَ بِالْمَلَكَةِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْخَلْقِ
segments.transliteration: wa jaa'la lanaal-faz''eelata bil-malakati a'laa jameei'l-khal-q
segments.translation: 62.and appointed for us excellence through domination over all creation;
63.every one of His creatures submits to us through His power
64.and comes to obey us through His might.

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لله الَّذِي أَغْلَقَ عَنَّا بَابَ الْحَّاجَةِ إلاّ إلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: wal-h'am-du lil-lahil-ld'eee agh-laqa a'n-naa baabal-h'aajati il-laaa ilay-h
segments.translation: 65.Praise belongs to God, who locked for us the gate of need except toward Him.

segments.arabic: فَكَيْفَ نُطِيقُ حَمْدَهُ أَمْ مَتَى نُؤَدِّي شُكْرَهُ؟ لا، مَتى؟
segments.transliteration: fakay-fa nut'eequ h'am-dahu? am mataa noo-ad-dee shuk-rahu? laa mataa?
segments.translation: 66.So how can we praise Him? When can we thank Him? Indeed, when?

segments.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي رَكَّبَ فِينَا آلاَتِ الْبَسْطِ
segments.translation: 67.Praise belongs to God, who placed within us the organs of expansion,
68.assigned for us the agents of contraction,
69.gave us to enjoy the spirits of life,
70.fixed within us the limbs of works,
71.nourished us with the agreeable things of provision,
72.freed us from need through His bounty,
73.and gave us possessions through His kindness.
74.Then He commanded us that He might test our obedience

segments.arabic: وَنَهَانَا لِيَبْتَلِيَ شُكْرَنَا فَخَالَفْنَا عَنْ طَرِيْقِ أمْرِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa nahaanaa leeab-taleea shuk-ranaa fakhaalaf-naa a'n t'areeqi am-rih
segments.translation: 75.and prohibited us that He might try our thanksgiving. So we turned against the path of His commandments
76.and mounted the backs of His warnings.

segments.transliteration: falam yab-tadir-naa biu'qoobatih wa lam yua'ajil-naa binaqimatih
segments.translation: 77.Yet He hurried us not to His punishment,nor hastened us on to His vengeance, ,

segments.arabic: بَلْ تَانَّانا بِرَحْمَتِهِ تَكَرُّماً، وَانْتَظَرَ مُراجَعَتَنَا بِرَأفَتِهِ حِلْماً.
segments.transliteration: bal taan-naanaa birah'-matihee takar-rumaawa antaz'ara muraajaa'tanaa biraa-fatihee h'il-maa
segments.translation: 78.No, He went slowly with us through His mercy, in generosity, and awaited our return through His clemency, in mildness.
79.Praise belongs to God, who showed us the way to repentance,

segments.arabic: الَّتِي لَمْ نُفِدْهَا إلاّ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ،
segments.transliteration: allatee lam nufid-haaa il-laa min faz''-lih
segments.translation: 80.which we would not have won save through His bounty.
81.Had we nothing to count as His bounty

segments.transliteration: il-laa bihaa laqad h'asuna balaaaw-uhoo i'ndanaa
segments.translation: 82.but this, His trial of us would have been good,
83.His beneficence toward us great,
84.His bounty upon us immense.

segments.arabic: فَمَا هكذا كَانَتْ سُنَّتُهُ فِي التَّوْبَةِ
segments.translation: 85.For such was not His wont in repentance
86.with those who went before us.
87.He has lifted up from us
88."what we have not the strength to bear"(2:286) ,
89.charged us only to our capacity,
90.imposed upon us nothing but ease,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَدَعْ لاَحَـد مِنَّا حُجَّةً وَلاَ عُذْراً
segments.transliteration: wa lam yadaa' liah'adim-min-naa h'uj-jataw-wa laa u'd'-raa
segments.translation: 91.and left none of us with an argument or excuse.
92.So the perisher among us is he who perishes in spite of Him
93.and the felicitous among us he who beseeches Him.

segments.arabic: وَ الْحَمْد للهِ بِكُلِّ مَا حَمِدَهُ بِهِ
segments.transliteration: wal-h'am-du lil-lahee bikul-li maa h'amidahoo bihee
segments.translation: 94.And praise belongs to God with all the praises of
95.His angels closest to Him,
96.His creatures most noble in His eyes,
97.and His praisers most pleasing to Him;
98.a praise that may surpass other praises
99.as our Lord surpasses all His creatures.
100.Then to Him belongs praise,
101.in place of His every favour upon us

segments.arabic: وَ عَلى جَمِيعِ عِبَادِهِ الْمَاضِينَ وَالْبَاقِينَ
segments.translation: 102.and upon all His servants, past and still remaining,

segments.arabic: عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُهُ مِنْ جَمِيعِالاشْيَآءِ
segments.transliteration: a'dada maaa ah'aat'a bihee i'l-muhoo min jameei'l-ash-yaaa-i
segments.translation: 103.to the number of all things His knowledge encompasses,

segments.arabic: وَ مَكَانَ كُلِّ وَاحِدَة مِنْهَا عَدَدُهَا
segments.translation: 104.and in place of each of His favours,

segments.arabic: أَضْعافَاً مُضَاعَفَةً أَبَداً سَرْمَداً إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
segments.translation: 105.their number doubling and redoubling always and forever, to the Day of Resurrection;
106.a praise whose bound has no utmost end,
107.whose number has no reckoning,
108.whose limit cannot be reached,
109.whose period cannot be cut off;

segments.arabic: حَمْدَاً يَكُونُ وُصْلَةً إلَى طَاعَتِهِ وَعَفْوِهِ
segments.transliteration: h'am-day-yakoonu wus'-latan ilaa t'aaa'tihee wa a'f-wih
segments.translation: 110.a praise which will become a link to His obedience and pardon,
111.a tie to His good pleasure,
112.a means to His forgiveness,
113.a path to His Garden,
114.a protector against His vengeance,
115.a security against His wrath,
116.an aid to obeying Him,
117.a barrier against disobeying Him,

segments.arabic: وَعَوْناً عَلَى تَأدِيَةِ حَقِّهِ وَ وَظائِفِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa a'w-nan a'laa taa-deeati h'aq-qihee wawaz'aaa-ifih
segments.translation: 118.a help in fulfilling His right and His duties;

segments.arabic: حَمْداً نَسْعَدُ بِهِ فِي السُّعَدَاءِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآئِهِ
segments.transliteration: h'am-daan nas-a'du bihee fis-sua'daaa-i min aw-leeaaa-ih
segments.translation: 119.a praise that will make us felicitous among His felicitous friends,

segments.arabic: وَنَصِيرُ بِهِ فِي نَظْمِ الشُّهَدَآءِ بِسُيُوفِ أَعْدَائِهِ
segments.transliteration: nas'eeru bihee fee naz'-mish-shuhadaaa-i bisuyoofi aa'-daaa-ih
segments.translation: 120.and bring us into the ranks of those martyred by the swords of His enemies.
121.He is a Friend, Praiseworthy!

text: Rajab 15th Duas.org       Rajab 15th Aamal for the 15th Eve/Day of Rajab Month Rajab Month index Significance Significance × From Iqbal Aamal:- Section 60 On the Secrets of the 15th Rajab Beware that this is the day for which there are secrets and many gifts are bestowed on it, the poor become needless and the grief-stricken people will feel relief. Thus you should turn to God and ask him to improve your affairs. Consider yourself to be in the presence of the Lord and a guest of the Prophet (as). Remember that you might not live and see the next middle day of the month of Rajab! The following narration has been reported on the authority of Ibn Abbas. Adam (as) said: âOâ Lord! Please let me know of Your most loved days and times.â Then God the Blessed the Sublimed revealed to him, âOâ Adam! The most loved times for me are the middle day of the month of Rajab. Oâ Adam! Seek proximity to me on the middle day of the month of Rajab by offering, feeding people, fasting, reciting supplications and asking for forgiveness and saying, âThere is no God but God.â Oâ Adam! I have destined to appoint a Prophet (as) from your lineage who is not bad-tempered and does not yell in the bazaar. He is kind, merciful, and highly blessed. I will especially honor him and his nation with the middle day of the month of Rajab. I shall grant whatever asked for. I shall forgive whoever asks for forgiveness. I shall provide for whoever asks for provisions. I shall overlook any mistakes. I shall have Mercy upon whoever asks for Mercy. Oâ Adam! segments.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord.
I do not associate anyone with Him

segments.transliteration: wa la attakhidhu min dunihi waliyyan
segments.translation: and I do not betake any Master other than Him.
All glory be to Allah,all praise be to Allah,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ اكْبَرُ
segments.transliteration: wa laÂ ilaha illaÂ allahu wallahu akbaru
segments.translation: there is no god save Allah,and Allah is the Greatest.
Allah, Allah is my Lord.
I do not associate anyone with Him.
Only shall that which Allah wills happen.

segments.arabic: لاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
segments.transliteration: laÂ quwwata illaÂ billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: There is no power save with Allah, the Most High, the All-great.
O Allah, O He Who humiliates all the tyrants!
O He Who dignifies the believers!
Verily, You are my Shelter when all courses mislead me

segments.transliteration: wa anta bari'u khalqi rahmatan bi
segments.translation: and You are the Maker of my creation out of Your having mercy upon me,
while You have never needed to create me.

segments.transliteration: wa lawla rahmatuka lakuntu min alhalikina
segments.translation: Were it not for Your mercy, I would be of those who perish.
You are my backer against my enemies,

segments.arabic: وَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إِيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ ٱلْمَفْضُوحِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa lawla nasruka iyyaya lakuntu min almafduhina
segments.translation: and were it not for Your support, I would be of those who are exposed.
O He Who sends mercy from its origin!
O He Who originates blessings from their centers!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ خَصَّ نَفْسَهُ بِٱلشُّمُوخِ وَٱلرِّفْعَةِ
segments.transliteration: ya man khassa nafsahu bilshshumukhi walrrif`ati
segments.translation: O He Who has given Himself exclusively disdain and elevation;
therefore, His saints feel dignified out of His Honor!

segments.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ ٱلْمَذَلَّةِ عَلَىٰ أَعْنَاقِهِمْ
segments.transliteration: wa ya man wada`at lahu almuluku nira almadhallati `ala a`naqihim
segments.translation: O He for Whom all kings have put the yoke of humiliation on their necks;
they are therefore fearful of His supremacy!

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِكَيْنُونِيَّتِكَ ٱلَّتِي ٱشْتَقَقْتَهَا مِنْ كِبْرِيَائِكَ
segments.transliteration: as'aluka bikaynuniyyatika allati ishtaqaqtaha min kibriya'ika
segments.translation: I pray You in the name of Your Entity from which You have derived Your Pride,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكِبْرِيَائِكَ ٱلَّتِي ٱشْتَقَقْتَهَا مِنْ عِزَّتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa as'aluka bikibriya'ika allati ishtaqaqtaha min `izzatika
segments.translation: I pray You in the name of Your Pride from which You have derived Your Dignity,

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزِّتِكَ ٱلَّتِي ٱسْتَوَيْتَ بِهَا عَلَىٰ عَرْشِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa as'aluka bi`izzatika allati istawayta biha `ala `arshika
segments.translation: I pray You in the name of Your Dignity by which You have been firmly established on the throne of authority;
so, You have created all Your creatures who are,
as a result, submissive to You.

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi
segments.translation: [I pray You to] send blessings to Muhammad and upon his Household.
There is no god save Allah,
the One and Only Who has no partner.
To him is the kingdom and to Him is all praise.
He gives life and causes to die
while He is Ever-living and never dies.
In His hand is the good
and He has power over all things.
The Lord Who is One, One and Only,
Singular, and Besought by the all,

segments.transliteration: lam yattakhidh sahibatan wa la waladan
segments.translation: has betaken neither a wife nor a son.
