segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, in Allah (I trust),
and on Allah do I rely.

segments.arabic: إِنَّهُ مَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
segments.transliteration: innahu man yatawakkal `ala allahi fahuwa hasbuhu
segments.translation: Verily, whoever trusts in Allah, He is sufficient for him.
Surely, Allah attains His purpose.

segments.arabic: قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْراً
segments.transliteration: qad ja`ala allahu likulli shay'in qadran
segments.translation: Allah indeed has appointed a measure for everything.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنِي فِي كَنَفِكَ وَفِي جِوَارِكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`alni fi kanafika wa fi jiwarika
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) put me under Your shade and in Your vicinity

segments.transliteration: waj`alni fi amanika wa fi man`ika
segments.translation: and put me under Your security and in Your shield.
O Allah, (please) entertain my loneliness,
secure my dread,
and help me against my being alone.
I pray for Your protection the perfect Words of Allah
and all of His excellent names totally
against the evil of poisonous things and the pestles,
against the evil of all evil eyes,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri hasidin idha hasada
segments.translation: and against the evil of the envious when he envies.
O black, leaping fleas

segments.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لاَ يُبَالِي غَلَقاً وَلاَ بَاباً
segments.transliteration: alladhi la yubali ghalaqan wa la baban
segments.translation: that care for neither a lock nor a door,
I adjure you in the name of the Mother of the Book
not to annoy my companions and me
until night terminates
and morning comes carrying what it carries.
I pray the protection of the Lord of Daniel and the well (in which Daniel was thrown with beasts)
against all strong, ravenous lions.
I adjure you by the adjuration of Allah,

segments.arabic: وَعَزِيمَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.transliteration: wa `azimati muhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: the adjuration of Muhammad, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household,
the adjuration of Solomon the son of David,

segments.arabic: وَعَزِيمَةِ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
segments.transliteration: wa `azimati amiri almu'minina `aliyyi ibni abi talibin `alayhi alssalamu
segments.translation: the adjuration of the Commander of the Faithful `Ali the son of Abi-Talib, peace be upon him,

segments.arabic: وَٱلأَئِمَّةِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ
segments.translation: and the adjuration of the immaculate Imams after him, peace be upon them.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظيِمِ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
segments.translation: There is neither might nor power save with Allah the All-high and All-great.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bihaqqi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: to bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.transliteration: wa an tunjiyani min hadha alghammi
segments.translation: and to save me from this distress.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O He Who is Ever-living; O He Who is Self-subsisting,
in the name of Your mercy I pray for Your aid; so, (please) come to my aid,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ أَبَداً
segments.transliteration: wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata `aynin abadan
segments.translation: do not leave me with myself even for a winking of an eye,
and set aright my entire affair.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I put my trust).
I shut the mouths of jinn, human beings,
devils, sorcerers, demons,
both jinn and human beings,
rulers, and their protÃ©gÃ©s
in the name of Allah the Almighty and Mightiest,
in the name of Allah the Great and Greatest,
and in the name of Allah that is evident, immanent,
hoarded, and stored,
and by which Allah has established the heavens and the earth
and then prevailed on the Throne.
âIn the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
And the word shall come to pass against them because they were unjust,
so they shall not speak.â

segments.transliteration: qala ikhsa'u fiha wa la tukallimuni
segments.translation: âHe shall say: Go away into it and speak not to Me.â
âAnd the faces shall be humbled before the Living, the Self-subsistent Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa qad khaba man hamala zulman
segments.translation: and he who bears iniquity is indeed in a failure.â
âAnd the voices shall be low before the Beneficent Allah
so that you shall not hear aught but a soft sound.â

segments.transliteration: wa ja`alna `ala qulubihim akinnatan an yafqahuhu
segments.translation: âAnd We have cast veils over their hearts lest they understand it
and a heaviness into their ears.â

segments.transliteration: wa idha dhakarta rabbaka fi alqur'ani wahdahu
segments.translation: âAnd when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'an
they turn their backs in aversion.â
âAnd when you recite the Qur'an,

segments.arabic: جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: ja`alna baynaka wa bayna alladhina la yu'minuna bilakhirati
segments.translation: We place between you and those who do not believe in the hereafter
a hidden barrier.â

segments.transliteration: wa ja`alna min bayni aydihim saddan
segments.translation: âAnd We have made before them a barrier
and a barrier behind them,
then We have covered them over so that they do not see.â
âOn that day, We will set a seal upon their mouths,
and their hands shall speak to Us.â
âSo, they shall not speak.â

segments.transliteration: law anfaqta ma fi al-ardi jami`an
segments.translation: âHad you spent all that is in the earth,
you could not have united their hearts,
but Allah united them.
Surely, He is Mighty, Wise.â

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his immaculate Household.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Creator of the creation!
O Amplifying of sustenance!
O Splitter of grains!
O Originator of spirits!
O Reviver of the dead!
O Deadener of the living!
O constantly Firm!
O Bringer forth of plants!
(Please) do to me what befits You to do,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa la taf`al bi ma ana ahluhu
segments.translation: but do not do to me what I deserve,

segments.transliteration: wa anta ahlu alttaqwa wa ahlu almaghfirati
segments.translation: for You are the worthiest to be feared and the worthiest to forgive.

segments.transliteration: ilahi kam min `aduwwin shahadha li zubata mudyatihi
segments.translation: O my God, too many are the enemies who honed their daggersâ edge against me,
sharpened the heads of their weapons against me,

segments.arabic: إِلٰهِي كَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ شَحَذَ لِي ظُبَةَ مُدْيَتِهِ
segments.translation: mixed for me their deadly poisons,
and kept a sleepless eye on me,

segments.transliteration: falamma ra'ayta da`fi an ihtimali alfawadihi
segments.translation: but when You considered that I am too weak to bear hardships
and I am too powerless to bear the accumulating cataclysms,

segments.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ ضَعْفِي عَنِ ٱحْتِمَالِ ٱلْفَوَادِحِ
segments.translation: You warded off all that from me through Your might and power,

segments.transliteration: la bihawlin minni wa la quwwatin
segments.translation: but not through my might or power.

segments.transliteration: fa'alqaytahu fi alhafiri alladhi ihtafarahu li
segments.translation: You have thus thrown him in the hole, which he had dug for me,
making him lose any hope he had in this world

segments.arabic: فَأَلْقَيْتَهُ فِي ٱلْحَفِيرِ ٱلَّذِي ٱحْتَفَرَهُ لِي
segments.translation: and move away from what he had expected in the Hereafter.
So, all praise be to you for that;
praise that is comparable to what You deserve, O my master.
So, O Allah, (please) grasp him by Your almightiness,
notch his sharpness against me with Your omnipotence,
and cause him to be engaged with what will inflict him
and to be too weak to face his rivals.
O Allah, (please) help me against his animosity with such help that is in progress
and due to which my rage will be healed
and my anger will protect me against him.
O Allah, (please) connect my prayer with Your response,
attach my complaint to the reply that changes my state,
show him very soon and practically what You have prepared threateningly for the wrongdoers,

segments.transliteration: wa `arrifni ma wa`adta fi ijabati almudtarrina
segments.translation: and show me very soon and practically how You respond to the distressed ones.

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْهُ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ مَا أَوْعَدْتَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
segments.translation: Verily, You are the Lord of great favor

segments.arabic: وَعَرِّفْنِي مَا وَعَدْتَ فِي إِجَابَةِ ٱلْمُضْطَرِّينَ
segments.translation: and generous conferral.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
In the Name of Allah.

segments.transliteration: inni a`udhu bilrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan
segments.translation: Surely, I seek refuge in the Beneficent Allah from you, if you are pious
or impious.

segments.arabic: إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمٰنِ مِنْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيّاً
segments.translation: I seek Allah the All-hearing and All-seeing
to guard me against your hearing and your sight.
You have authority neither over me,
nor over my hearing,
nor over my sight,
nor over my hair,
nor over my skin,
nor over my flesh,
nor over my blood,
nor over my brain,
nor over my veins,
nor over my bones,
nor over my property,
nor over what my Lord has provided me.

segments.transliteration: satartu bayni wa baynaka bisitri alnnubuwwati
segments.translation: I block between you and me with the blockage of prophecy
with which the prophets of Allah blocked
against the sways of the tyrants and the oppressive rules.
Gabriel is to my right side,
Michael to my left side,
Seraph to my backside,

segments.transliteration: wa muhammadun salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi amami
segments.translation: Muhammad, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household, to my front side,
and Allah is overseeing me

segments.arabic: وَمُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَمَامِي
segments.translation: to prevent you from me
and prevent Satan from me.
O Allah, let not his intolerance overcome Your forbearance
lest he may provoke and belittle me.
O Allah, to You do I resort.
O Allah, to You do I resort.
O Allah, to You do I resort.
O Light! O Demonstrative Argument!
O Evident! O Brilliant!
O Lord, (please) save me from all evils
and vicissitudes of times,

segments.transliteration: wa as'aluka alnnajata yawma yunfakhu fi alssuri
segments.translation: and I beseech You for redemption on the day when the Trumpet will be blown.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

segments.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ ٱلنَّجَاةَ يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ
segments.translation: O Mighty of all might in His almightiness!
How mighty the mighty of all might in His almightiness is!
O Mighty, (please) make me mighty in the name of Your almightiness,

segments.arabic: مَا أَعَزَّ عَزِيزَ ٱلْعِزِّ فِي عِزِّهِ
segments.translation: aide me with Your support,
ward off from me the inspirations of devils,
defend me with Your defense,
protect me with Your making,
and make me of the best of Your creatures.
O One! O One and Only!
O Unique! O eternally besought of all.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O my means in my ordeals!
O my aide in my agonies!
O my entertainment in my loneliness!
(Please) guard me with Your eye that never sleeps
and embrace me with Your support that is invincible.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O owner of all selves!
O defeater of the allies!
O opener of all doors!
O creator of all causes!
(Please) create for us a cause
that we cannot find anywhere else,
in the name of âThere is no god but Allah.
Muhammad is the messenger of Allah.â
May Allahâs blessings be upon him and all of the members of his Household.

segments.transliteration: ma man awa ila ma'wan fa'anta ma'waya
segments.translation: O Allah, if someone may resort to a shelter, then my shelter is You.

segments.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
segments.transliteration: wa man laja'a ila malja'in fa'anta malja'i
segments.translation: If someone may seek refuge in an asylum, they my asylum is You.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَوَىٰ إِلَىٰ مَأْوَىًٰ فَأَنْتَ مَأْوَايَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَمَنْ لَجَأَ إِلىٰ مَلْجإٍ فَأَنْتَ مَلْجَئِي
segments.translation: listen to my call,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: respond to my prayer,
decide my final return and abode to be with You,
and guard me, when I am afflicted by an ordeal,
against failure in the trial
and against the influence of Satan,

segments.transliteration: bi`azamatika allati la yashubuha wala`u nafsin bitaftinin
segments.translation: [please do it] in the name of Your greatness that is admixed with neither infatuating fondness
nor assumed and transitory apparition

segments.arabic: بِعَظَمَتِكَ ٱلَّتِي لاَ يَشُوبُهَا وَلَعُ نَفْسٍ بِتَفْتِينٍ
segments.transliteration: wa la yalummu biha farahun hatta taqlibani ilayka bi'iradatika
segments.translation: and is not charmed by a joyful situation, until You decide to take me to You by Your will
while I am neither accused, suspect,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ يَلُمُّ بِهَا فَرَحٌ حَتَّىٰ تَقْلِبَنِي إِلَيْكَ بِإِرَادَتِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa la murabin wa la murtabin
segments.translation: suspicious, nor doubtful.
Verily, You are the most merciful of all those who show mercy.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
There is no god but Allah.
In Him do I put my trust
and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
What Allah wills shall come to pass,

segments.transliteration: wa ma lam yasha' lam yakun
segments.translation: but what He does not will shall never come to pass.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu anna allaha `ala kulli shay'in qadirun
segments.translation: I bear witness that Allah has power over all things

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha qad ahata bikulli shay'in `ilman
segments.translation: and Allah has encompassed all things in His knowledge.

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min sharri nafsi
segments.translation: O Allah, I pray Your protection against the evils of my self

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْماً
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli dabbatin anta akhidhun binasiyatiha
segments.translation: and against the evil of every living creature that You hold by its forelock.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
segments.translation: Surely, my Lord is on the right path.

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
In the Name of Allah; the best of all names.
In the Name of Allah; the Lord of the earth and the heavens.

segments.transliteration: bismillahi alladhi la yadurru ma`a ismihi sammun wa la da'un
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah with Whose Name, neither poison nor malady can harm.
In the Name of Allah, I begin my day

segments.arabic: بِسمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ ٱسْمِهِ سَمٌّ وَلاَ دَاءٌ
segments.translation: and in Allah, I put my trust.
In the Name of Allah on my heart and my self.
In the Name of Allah on my faith and my intellect.
In the Name of Allah on my family members and my property.
In the Name of Allah on what Allah has given me.

segments.transliteration: bismillahi alladhi la yadurr ma`a ismihi shay'un
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah with Whose Name nothing can ever harm

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَىٰ مَا أَعْطَانِي رَبِّي
segments.transliteration: fi al-ardi wa la fi alssama'i
segments.translation: neither in the earth nor in the heavens,

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ ٱسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ
segments.translation: and He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.
Allah, Allah is my Lord.
I do not associate any thing with Him.
Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: allahu akbaru wa a`azzu wa ajallu
segments.translation: Allah is greater, mightier, and more majestic
than what I fear and what I am afraid of.
Strong is one who is in Your vicinity,
majestic is the praise of You,
and there is no god save You.

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min sharri nafsi
segments.translation: O Allah, I pray Your protection against the evil of my self,

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli sultanin shadidin
segments.translation: the evil of all stern rulers,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli shaytanin maridin
segments.translation: the evil of all rebellious devils,
the evil of all obstinate tyrants,
the evil of all misfortunate decrees,

segments.transliteration: wa min kulli dabbatin anta akhidhun binasiyatiha
segments.translation: and [the evil of] all living creatures that You grasp from the forelock.
Verily, You are on a straight path

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا
segments.translation: and You are the custodian over all things.

segments.transliteration: inn waliyyiya allahu alladhi nazzala alkitaba
segments.translation: âSurely, my guardian is Allah Who revealed the Book
and He keeps the righteous people under His custody.â

segments.arabic: «إِنَّ وَ لِيِّيَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ ٱلْكِتَابَ
segments.translation: âBut if they turn back, then say, âAllah is sufficient for me.
There is no god but He.
On Him do I rely
and He is the Lord of mighty power.ââ
O Allah, I pray Your protection
lest that I may be needy while Your riches are there for me,
I may be led astray while Your guidance is there for me,
I may be humiliated while Your honoring is there for me,
I may be subjugated while Your absolute authority is there for me,
or I may be persecuted while the entire affair is Yours.
O Allah, I pray Your protection
lest I may say false things,
commit wickedness,
or be seduced to exceed Your limits.
In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
Sufficient to me is Allah.
I put my trust in Allah.

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka khayra umuri kulliha
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You for success in all of my affairs

segments.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min khizyi alddunya wa `adhabi al-akhirati
segments.translation: and I pray Your protection against disgrace in this world and chastisement in the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ أُمُورِي كُلِّهَا
segments.transliteration: ya man idha ista`adhtu bihi a`adhani
segments.translation: O He Who unquestionably protects me whenever I pray Him for protection,

segments.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ خِزْيِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ ٱلآخِرَةِ
segments.transliteration: wa idha istajartu bihi `inda alshshada'idi ajarani
segments.translation: Who unquestionably shelters me whenever I pray for His shelter against hardships,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ إِذَا ٱسْتَعَذْتُ بِهِ أَعَاذَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa idha istaghathtu bihi `inda alnnawa'ibi aghathani
segments.translation: Who unquestionably aids me whenever I pray for His aid at calamities,

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱسْتَجَرْتُ بِهِ عِنْدَ ٱلشَّدَائِدِ أَجَارَنِي
segments.transliteration: wa idha istansartu bihi `ala `aduwwi nasarani wa a`anani
segments.translation: and Who unquestionably supports and assists me whenever I pray for His support against my enemy.

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱسْتَغَثْتُ بِهِ عِنْدَ ٱلنَّوَائِبِ أَغَاثَنِي
segments.translation: Towards You is the flight

segments.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱسْتَنْصَرْتُ بِهِ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّي نَصَرَنِي وَأَعَانَنِي
segments.translation: and You are the most trustful;
so, (please) subdue whoever intends evil to me
and overcome whoever plots against me.

segments.transliteration: ya man qala in yansurkum allahu fala ghaliba lakum
segments.translation: O He Who has said, âIf Allah assists you, then there is none that can overcome you.â

segments.transliteration: ya man najja nuhan min alqawmi alzzalimina
segments.translation: O He Who has saved Noah from the oppressing people!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ قَالَ «إِنْ يَنْصُرْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَلاَ غَالِبَ لَكُمْ.»
segments.transliteration: ya man najja lutan min alqawmi alfasiqina
segments.translation: O He Who has saved Lot from the wicked people!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ نُوحاً مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
segments.transliteration: ya man najja hudan min alqawmi al`adina
segments.translation: O He Who has saved Hud from the transgressing people!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ لُوطاً مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَاسِقِينَ
segments.transliteration: ya man najja muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi min alqawmi alkafirina
segments.translation: O He Who has saved Muhammad, Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household, from the disbelieving people!

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ هُوداً مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْعَادِينَ
segments.translation: (Please) save me from my and Your enemies,

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ
segments.translation: in the name of Your Names; O All-beneficent, O All-merciful.

segments.transliteration: la sabila lahum `ala man ta`awwadha bilqur'ani
segments.translation: They have no way to harm whoever prays the protection of the Qur'an
and prays the shelter of You in the name of Your Names: the All-merciful and the All-beneficent.

segments.arabic: لاَ سَبِيلَ لَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَنْ تَعَوَّذَ بِٱلْقُرْآنِ
segments.translation: âThe All-beneficent is firmly established on the throne (of authority).â
âTruly, strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life),
and He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
Lord of the Throne of Glory,
and Doer (without let) of all that He intends.â
âBut if they turn away, then say: âAllah suffices me:
there is no god but He.:
On Him is my trust,
and He the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme.ââ
I put my trust in the ever-living Lord Who never dies.
I pray the immunity of the Lord of almightiness and omnipotence.

segments.arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
segments.translation: I pray the aid of the Lord of grandeur and kingdom.
O my Master, I surrender to You; so, (please) do not disappoint me,
I put my trust in You; so, (please) do not thwart me,

segments.transliteration: wa laja'tu ila zillika albasiti fala tatrahni
segments.translation: and to Your extensive shadow do I resort; so, (please) do not throw me away.
You are the utmost purpose and to You are all flights made.

segments.arabic: وَلَجَأْتُ إِلَىٰ ظِلِّكَ ٱلْبَسِيطِ فَلاَ تَطْرَحْنِي
segments.transliteration: ta`lamu ma ukhfi wa ma u`linu
segments.translation: You know whatever I hide and whatever I do openly.

segments.transliteration: wa ta`lamu kha'inata al-a`yuni wa ma tukhfi alssuduru
segments.translation: You know the stealthy looks of eyes and what is concealed in breasts.
So, O Allah, (please) withhold the hands of the transgressors against me,

segments.arabic: وَتَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ ٱلأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ
segments.translation: including all jinn and all human beings,
heal me, and grant me wellbeing,
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!
The Creator is greater than the creatures.
The Sustaining Lord is more liberal than the sustained beings.
The awning over fire of Allah
in outstretched columns
will frustrate the plots of the hearts of the rebellious
and will thwart the trickeries of the envious
in the name of the Oaths, the Decrees,
the Preserved Tablet,
the Hanged Down Screen,
and the Throne of our Great Lord.
I seek the screen, the covering,
the shelter, the safeguard,

segments.transliteration: wa tahassantu bi-alif lam mim wa bikaf ha' ya' `ayn sad
segments.translation: and the haven of âail-lam-mim,â âkaf-ha'-ya'-`ayn-sad,â

segments.transliteration: wa bita ha wa bita' sin mim
segments.translation: âta-ha,â âta'-sin-mim,â

segments.transliteration: wa biha' mim wa biha' mim `ayn sin qaf wa nun
segments.translation: âha'-mim,â âha'-mim-`ayn-sin-qaf,â ânun,â

segments.transliteration: wa bita sin wa biqaf walqur'ani almajidi
segments.translation: âta-sin,â âqaf,â âthe Glorious Qur'an,â
and âAnd most surely, it is a very great oath if you only knew.â
Allah is my guardian, and the most excellent protector is He.
O All-compassionate! O All-merciful!

segments.transliteration: allahumma inna dhunubi lam yabqa laha illa raja'u `afwika
segments.translation: O Allah, nothing has indeed left for my sins except my hope for You pardon

segments.transliteration: wa qad qaddamtu alata alhirmani bayna yadayya
segments.translation: although I have done things due to which I deserve deprivation of Your pardon.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ ذُنُوبِي لَمْ يَبْقَ لَهَا إِلاَّ رَجَاءُ عَفْوِكَ
segments.translation: Therefore, I beseech You for what I do not deserve,

segments.arabic: وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ آلَةَ ٱلْحِرْمَانِ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ
segments.translation: I seek from You what I do not merit,

segments.transliteration: wa atadarra`u ilayka bima la asta'hiluhu
segments.translation: and I implore You for what I do not earn.
My situation is not concealed from You

segments.transliteration: wa in khafiya `ala alnnasi kunhu ma`rifati amri
segments.translation: although the actual knowledge of my manners is hidden from people.

segments.transliteration: allahumma in kana rizqi fi alssama'i fa'ahbithu
segments.translation: O Allah, if my sustenance in the sky, then (please) send it down to me,

segments.arabic: وَإِنْ خَفِيَ عَلَىٰ ٱلنَّاسِ كُنْهُ مَعْرِفَةِ أَمْرِي
segments.transliteration: wa in kana fi al-ardi fa'azhirhu
segments.translation: if it is in the earth, then (please) show it to me,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ رِزْقِي فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ فَأَهْبِطْهُ
segments.translation: if it is far off, then (please) draw it near me,
if it is near, then (please) make it easy for me to reach it,
and if it is little, then (please) multiply it for me
and grant me its blessings.
O Allah, Iblis is not but one of Your servants;
he can see me from whence I cannot see him,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ عَبْدٌ مِنْ عَبِيدِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa anta tarahu min haythu la yaraka
segments.translation: but You can see him from whence he cannot see You.
While You have full power over all of his deeds,

segments.arabic: وَأَنْتَ تَرَاهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ يَرَاكَ
segments.transliteration: wa huwa la yaqwa `ala shay'in min amrika
segments.translation: he has no power over any of Your decrees.

segments.transliteration: allahumma fa'ana asta`inu bika `alayhi ya rabbi
segments.translation: So, O Allah, I pray Your help against him, O Lord,

segments.arabic: وَهُوَ لاَ يَقْوَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
segments.translation: for I have no strength to challenge him

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَأَنَا أَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَيْهِ يَا رَبِّ
segments.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata li `alayhi illa bika ya rabbi
segments.translation: and I have neither might nor power against him except through You, O my Lord.
O Allah, if he intends evil to me, then (please) deter him,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ لِي عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ
segments.translation: if he plots against me, then (please) plot against him,
save me from his evils,
and make his trickery to be hanged to his own neck,
in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

segments.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi alttahirina
segments.translation: May Allah bless Muhammad and his Immaculate Household.

segments.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ

segments.arabic: بسم الله من أوليه إلى آخره
segments.translation: (In the Name of Allah from its beginning to its end).

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ . اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
اَللَّهُمَّ اِنِّي  اَسْئَلُكَ  فِي اَكْلِي وَ شُرْبِي السَّلاَمَةَ مِنْ وَعْكَهِ وَ الْقُوَّةَ بِهِ عَلى طَاعَتِكَ وَ ذِكْرِكَ وَ شُكْرِكَ ،
 فِيْمَا اَبْقَيْتَهُ فِي بَدَنِي وَ اَنْ تَشَجِّعْنِي بِقُوَّتِهَا عَلى عِبَادَتِكَ وَ اَنْ تُلْهِمَنِي حُسْنَ التَّحْرِرِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ. 
 اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration:
bismillaahir rah'maanir rah'eem
li-eelaafi qurayshin
eelaafihim rih'latash shitaa-i was'-s'ayf
fal ya'-budoo rabba haad'al bayt
allad'ee at'-a'mahum min joo-i'w wa aamanahum min khawf
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family. O Allah, I ask You, in my eating and drinking, safety from illness, and to obey You and remember You and be thankful to You,  as long as it remains in my body, and through its strength encourage me towards Your worship and inspire me to refrain from Your disobedience. O Allah bless Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ أَللّٰهُمَّ مَا أَحْسَنَ مَا تَبْتَلِينَا، سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَكْثَرَ مَا تُعْطِيناَ، سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَكْثَرَ مَا تُعَافِينَا. أَللّٰهُمَّ أَوْسِعْ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلـى فُقَرَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ.
segments.transliteration: lahum rizquhum feehaa bukrataw wa a'shiyyaa
segments.translation: Glory be to You O  "Allah" ! How wonderful is that which You have tested us with. Glory be to You, how plentiful is that which You have given us. Glory be to You, how plentiful is that which You have bestowed on us. O Allah! Increase for us (our sustenance) and for the poor believing men and women and (for the poor) Muslim men and women.[i]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ. أَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا نِعْمَةً مَشْكُورَةً تَصِلُ بِهَا نِعْمَةَ الْجَنَّةِ.
segments.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi saqani maâan âadhban, walam yaj âalhu milhan ujajan bidhunubi
segments.translation: In the name of  "Allah" . O Allah! Make it an appreciated blessing by means of which the bounties of paradise are attained.[ii]

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ، بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَعَلَيْكَ خَلْفَهُ.
segments.transliteration: Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim. Alhamdu lillahil ladhi saqani fa-arwani, wa-aâtani wa-ardani, wa-âafani wakafani. Allahummajâalni mim-man tasqihi fil maâadi min hawdi Muhammadin sallal-lahu âalayhi wa-alih. Watus âidhu bimurafaqatih, birahmatika ya arhamar rahimin. Allahumma salli âala Muhammadiwn wa-ali Muhammad
segments.translation: In the name of Allah  (O Allah!) bless for us from what you have given us of sustenance and upon You do we rely for its replenishment.[i]

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَبْدِلْنَا بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: alhamd lilh munzil alma' min alssama' wamusarrif al'amr kayf yasha' bism alllahÂ khayrÂ al'asma'i
segments.translation: O  "Allah" ! Bless it for us and replenish it with that which is better.

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ.
segments.transliteration: Allahummajaâlhu Ilman Nafian Wa Rizqan Wasian Wa Shifa-am Min Kulli Daaiw wa Suqam.
segments.translation: O Allah   ! Bless it for us and increase it for us.[i]

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَطْعَمْتَ وَأَسْقَيْتَ وَرَوَيْتَ. فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ غَيْرُ مَكْفُورٍ وَلاَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنـى عَـنْكَ.
segments.translation: O  "Allah" ! Praise be to You. You have nourished and quenched and satisfied (us), so to You be praise - praise without ingratitude and without leave and without (seeking) independence from You.[iii]

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ كَمَا أَرَيْتَنَا أَوَّلَهَا فِي عَافِيةٍ فَأَرِنَا آخِرَهَا فِي عَافِيةٍ
segments.translation: O   "Allah" ! Just as You have shown us its beginning in well-being, show us its end in well-being.[i]

In the name of Allah, the beneficent, the merciful.
For the uniting of the Quraysh,
For the union during their winter and summer journeys,
Let them worship the Lord of this house,
Who fed them when they were hungry and gave them security against fear.
They shall have their sustenance therein, morning and evening.

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
 اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّد
اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِيْ اَطْعَمَنَا، وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَاَيَّدَنَا، وَآوانَا، وَاَنْعَمَ عَلَيْنَا، وَاَفْضَلَ. اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِيْ يُطْعِمُ وَلاَ يُطْعَمُ.
اَللهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدً وَآلِ مُحَمَّد
segments.translation:
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful

O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family 
Praise be to Allah Who has: fed us, provided water for us, sufficed us, supported us, sheltered us, favored us, and bestowed benefits.

Praise be to Allah Who feeds but is not fed.

O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ أَكْثَرْتَ وَأَطَبْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ فَأَشْبَعْتَ وَأَرْوَيْتَ. أَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي يُطْعِمُ وَلاَ يُطْعَمُ.
segments.translation: O   "Allah" ! You have increased Your bounties and made them good and blessed, thereby making us satiated and quenched. All praise be to Allah, The One who nourishes and is not nourished.[i]

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَقَانِي مَاءً عَذْبًا وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ مِلْحًا أُجَاجًا بِذُنُونِي
segments.translation: All praise belongs to Allah, Who has served me with fresh water, and He did not make it salty and bitter on account of my sins

segments.arabic: االْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي سَقَانِي فَأَرْوَانِي، وَأَعْطَانِي وَأَرْضَانِي وَعَافَانِي وَكَفَانِي اللهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ تَسْقِيهِ فِي الْمَعَادِ مِنْ حَوْضِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَتُسْعِدْهُ بِمُرَافَقَتِهِ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ اللّهُمّ صَلّ عَلَى مُحَمّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمّدٍ
segments.translation: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. All praise belongs to Allah, Who has served me with water to quench my thirst, provided for me and pleased me, given me good health and sufficed me. O Allah, make me amongst those who will drink water in the Hereafter from the spring of Muhammad â may Allah bless him and his family. And make it a good fortune by being in his company. With Your mercy, O the Most merciful, of the merciful. O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family.

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ مُنْزِلِ الْمَاءِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمُصَرِّفِ الْأَمْرِ کَیْفَ یَشَاءُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَیْرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ.
segments.translation: Praise be to God, who sends down water from the sky and decides the matter as He wills. In the name of God, the Best of Names.â

segments.arabic: اَللهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ عِلْماً نَافِعاً وَرِزْقاً وَاسِعاً وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ وَسُقْمٍ
segments.translation: O Allah! grant me useful knowledge, abundant sustenance and spare me all sickness and evil.

segments.arabic:
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَخْرِجْنِيْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ 
الْوَهْمِ وَ اَكْرِمْنِيْ بِنُوْرِ الْفَهْمِ
segments.transliteration: Allhumma Akhrijni min zulumatil wahmi ,wa akrimni be nuril fahmi .
segments.translation: O GOD, please bring me out of the darkness of doubt and favour me with the light of comprehension,

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ افْتَحْ عَلَيْنَا اَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ انْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا خَزَآئِنَ عُلُوْمِكَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma afta alayna abwaba rahmateka, wa anshur alyna khazaena uloomeka
segments.translation: O GOD open to us the doors of your mercy and unfold for us the treasure of your knowledge by your mercy
O the most merciful of the merciful ones.

segments.arabic: للَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْـتَنِي وَ عَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي
segments.transliteration: âAllahumma infa'nii bimaa 'allamtanii wa'allimnii maa yanfa'uunii.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Make useful for me what you have taught me and teach me knowledge that will be useful to me.

segments.arabic: .اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَهْمَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَ حِفْظَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segments.transliteration: Allahumma inii as'aluka fahmal-nabiyyen wa hifzal mursaleen al-muqarrabeen.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! I ask you for the understanding of the prophets and the memory of the messengers, and those nearest to you.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِسَانِي عَامِرًا بِذِكْرِكَ وَ قَلْبِي بِخَشْيَتِك.
segments.transliteration: .Allahumma ijal leesanee 'aiman bi dhikrika wa qalbi bi khashyatika.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Make my tongue full of your remembrance and my heart with awe of you.

segments.arabic: َ.إِنَّكَ عَلَى مَا تَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ وَ أَنْتَ حَسْـبُنَا اللَّهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
segments.transliteration: Innaka 'ala ma-tasha'u qadeer wa anta hasbun-allahu wa na'mal wakeel.'
segments.translation: Oh Allah! You do whatever you wish, and you are my availer and protector and best of aid.

segments.arabic: َللَّهُمَّ اَكْرِمْنْيْ بِنُوْرِ الْفَهْمِ وَ خَرَّجَنِيْ مِنْ ظُلُمَاتِ الْوَهْمِ
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma akrimnee binooril fahmi wa kharrajanee min z'ulumaatil wahmi
segments.translation: O Allah, honor me by the light of understanding and take me out from the darknesses of doubt
and open upon us the doors of Your knowledge

segments.arabic: وَ انْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا خُزَّانَ مَعْرِفَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ،
segments.transliteration: Wan shur a'lainaa khuzzaanu ma'rifatika yaa arh'amar raah'imeen.
segments.translation:
and open upon us the treasure of Your recognition,
 O the best of the Merciful ones.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْنِيْ فِىْ الْمُطَالَعَةِ بِحَلِّ جَمِيْعِ مُشْكِلاَتِ الْمَسَآئِلِ مِنَ الْكُتُبِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ.
segments.transliteration: Allaahumma waffiqnee fil mut'aala'ti bih'ablee jamee-i' mushkilaatil masaa-ili minal kutubi birah'matika yaa arh'amar raah'imeen
segments.translation: .O Allah, and give me Tawfeeq to the study and solving all the difficult problems through books. By Your mercy, O the best of the merciful ones

segments.arabic: للَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَ الْحَزَنِ  وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ العَجْزِ وَ الْكَسَلِ
segments.transliteration: Allhumma inni adhu bika min al-hammi wa al-hazan. Wa adhu bika min al-ajzi wa al-kasal.
segments.translation: Oh Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief,from helplessness and laziness,

segments.arabic: وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَ الْبُخْلِ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ و قَهْرِ الرجال
segments.transliteration: Wa adhu bika min al-jubni wa al-bukhl. Wa adhu bika min ghalabat id-dayni wa qahr ir-rijal.
segments.translation: from cowardice and stinginess,and from overpowering of debt and from oppression of men
